sources.note: Transport for NSW contactless payments page: riders pay with Apple Pay (incl. Express Mode) on Opal readers — open-loop contactless, not a provisioned Opal card in Wallet.
Wikipedia: Opal Next Gen (Opal 2.0) targeting rollout around 2028; no native Apple Wallet pass available as of August 2026.
NeatPass 2026 guide confirms no native Opal card in Apple Wallet; open-loop Apple Pay contactless is the only mobile option on the Opal network.
